rules.sentence: A biopsy is necessary after the physical exam, laboratory analysis, and diagnostic imaging confirm the presence of a lesion consistent with osteosarcoma.
The final surgical procedure must include resection of the biopsy tract, which can be tattooed for easy identification to avoid recurrence due to potential seeding of this tract with cancer cells.
An open approach to biopsy was previously considered the best option owing to a high accuracy rate.[14]
